_instructions: Every bot this repo deploys. A bot's name gives every other name:
stock-bot-3 → SSM prefix /stock-bot-3/, stack and ECR repo
environment: paper (stack 1 only: it hosts the Telegram ops function and
has no table), live, or experimental. deploy: auto deploys on every push
to main; manual only through the Deploy Live workflow.
To add a bot, run python scripts/new_bot.py stock-bot-<id> (see README).
